@everyone (only ping ur getting for this, promise)

CHARITY STREAM: sat nov 21, 10am to 10pm, for the linden community pantry

posting this early on purpose. last yr i posted it the thursday before, half of u didnt know till the day of, and we got $212. this yr the goal is $600 and i think we can actually hit it.

why the pantry: theyre feeding around 340 families a week rn and denise from the pantry told me the shelves are the lowest shes seen before thanksgiving. every $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food thru their wholesale partner, so even $3 is like 12 lbs of food.

donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz
goes straight to them, nothing taken off.

rook is matching the first $100, so the first hundred counts double.

what u get out of it:
$100 = i play a full round w the controller upside down
$250 = chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON STREAM
$400 = 1 hr of only chat picked songs, no skipping
$600 = i vlog the grocery pickup the pantry sets up

and yeah ive seen the "charity streams are cringe" take. fair, some of them are. but its not begging if u get hair dye content out of it lol. worst case u watch me suffer for 12 hrs and some families get groceries.

no card or just broke rn? thats fine, nobody's keeping track of who gave what. u can still help:
- canned or boxed food goes in the blue bin by the pantry's side door, saturdays 9 to 1
- show up, be loud in chat, share the link, clip the dumb stuff

the plan: first half is community lobbies (anyone can join, ill drop the code). second half chat votes on the game every 2 hrs. no repeat maps larry i promise.

put it in ur calendar now so nobody says they didnt know. see u the 21st
